body: Parks, Recreation and Community Services Commission Special Meeting
agenda_text:
PARKS, RECREATION & COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION

Welcome to the meeting of the Parks, Recreation & Community Services Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast
throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by calling
(818) 548-2090. Meetings are also archived on the City website for viewing anytime at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/management-
services/gtv6/watch-city-meetings. PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE MSB 105.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon
request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign
language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA 91206.
If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact (818) 548-2782 during regular business hours.

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  Monday, February 24, 2020, 2:30 p.m.
  Municipal Services Building, 633 E. Broadway, Room 105, Glendale, CA 91206

A SPECIAL MEETING of the Parks, Recreation & Community Services Commission is hereby called to
meet at 2:30 p.m. on Monday, February 24, 2020, in the City Council Chambers, 633 E. Broadway,
Room 105, Glendale, CA 91206 to consider the following item of business, to wit:

1.  ROLL CALL
  A. Report of Recording Clerk, re: Posting of the Agenda. The Agenda for the February 24, 2020,
  special meeting was posted on the bulletin board outside City Hall on or before Friday, February
  21, 2020.
2.  UPCOMING COUNCIL AGENDA ITEMS
3.  COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5) minutes. The
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision. The Director may refer
  the matter to the proper section for investigation and report.
5.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before a motion is
  proposed.
  A.  Approval of the Minutes of the Commission regular meeting held on November 18, 2019.
6.  ACTION ITEMS
  A. Summer 2019 Day Camp Review and Day Camp Fee Changes

7.  REPORTS – INFORMATION ONLY
  A. Parking Agreement with Glendale Community College (oral report)
  B. Glenoaks Park Update (oral report)
  C. Summer Aquatics Program Annual Report
  D. Verdugo Skate Park Annual Report
  E. Section Activity Reports
  1.  Park Services
  2.  Recreation & Community Services
8.  ADJOURNMENT
   Onnig Bulanikian
  Director of Community Services & Parks

  -------
  ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SERVICE
Members of the public may address the Parks, Recreation & Community Services Commission
regarding any item in this notice. Service of the above Call for Special Meeting of the Parks,
Recreation & Community Services Commission, at the time and place above designated, is hereby
acknowledged, and the Notice required by Government Code Section 54956 is hereby waived:
Hour:  a.m./p.m., this  day of  , 20 .
